title: Situated occurrence with an exact native text-unit return
description: A correctable research description of one particular use, not its Lexeme, written form, sense, TextUnit or Anchor. A frozen native binding fixes the addressed unit; linguistic attribution is expressed by separately assessed Claims. Unit granularity and proposed segmentation posture remain those of the native packet, never inferred from the description label.

occurrence_account.description: The source-described use and its uncertainty; its token, sentence or other granularity is not proof of a particular linguistic reading.

context_account.description: The situated reading context and limits, without turning surrounding text or a work label into an exact source binding.
